info.title: nanobom read API
info.description: Read what nanobom knows about organizations, projects, findings, components and runs. Every endpoint is read-only and checks access as the interface does: anything out of the caller's reach is 404, like something missing. Changes are additive (new endpoints, query parameters and response fields), so clients must ignore fields they do not know; see the guide for the stability promise.

get.description: The OpenAPI description of the read API. It needs no authentication.
The organizations the caller sees, by name. A token sees its own organization.
The organization's projects by slug, with their open findings by severity. A project token sees its project only.
The findings of a project version (the latest unless `version` names one) in the project page's order: known exploited first, then by severity, EPSS score, CVSS score, component and vulnerability.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: `all`, or a comma-separated list of `open`, `ignored` and `fixed`. Without it, open and ignored findings, as on the project page.

parameters.name: exploited
parameters.description: `true` for findings with a known exploited CVE only.

parameters.name: ecosystem
parameters.description: Only findings of this ecosystem: the package URL type (`npm`, `cargo`, `pypi`...).

get.description: The components of a project version (the latest unless `version` names one) from its latest SBOM, by package URL.

The latest runs that covered the organization (whole-instance runs, and runs of the organization or one of its projects), newest first. A project token sees whole-instance runs and runs of its project. Errors of whole-instance runs are shown to instance administrators only. Finding counts of whole-instance runs, which span every organization, are null for callers that are not instance administrators. There is no pagination: `offset` is refused with 422, and `limit` caps the list.
A finding with its vulnerability, history, dependency paths and the other projects it affects.

Components whose name contains `q`, whose license contains `license`, or both, in the active versions of the projects the caller sees (inactive versions too with `inactive=true`), by name then version, at most 200. A package in several versions of a project is one match per version. At least one of `q` and `license` is required. `truncated` says when more matched.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A name (`openssl`), optionally followed by a space or `@` and a version prefix (`openssl 3.`).

parameters.name: license
parameters.description: Text the component's license expression contains, case-insensitively (`GPL` matches `GPL-3.0-only` and `MIT OR GPL-2.0-or-later`). Components without a license never match.

get.description: The organization's license policy: the action for each listed license identifier, for licenses no rule lists, and for components whose license is unknown. An organization that never set one gets `allow` everywhere and `active: false`. The policy is changed in the interface only.

The components of a project version (the latest unless `version` names one) whose license the organization's policy forbids or warns about, computed from the current policy and the version's latest SBOM: forbidden components first, then warned ones, each by name then package URL. Empty, with `active: false`, when the organization has no active policy.
The project's versions, newest first, with the open findings of each by severity.

bearer.description: A token of either scope (upload or read), from the organization's settings or `nanobom token create`.

apiKey.name: X-Api-Key
apiKey.description: The same token, in the header Dependency-Track clients use.

session.name: nanobom_session
session.description: The interface's session, for pages of the same instance.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: The `ETag` of an earlier response: `304` while the data is unchanged.

Version.name: version
Version.description: The project version, by name; an empty value names the unnamed version. Without it, the latest version. An unknown version is 404.

ETag.description: A weak validator of the response body.

CacheControl.description: `private, no-cache`: shared caches must not store the response, and clients revalidate it with `If-None-Match`.

BadRequest.description: A path segment that is not valid percent-encoded UTF-8.

Unauthorized.description: No valid token, and no session.

NotFound.description: Missing, or out of the caller's reach.

role.description: The caller's role. Tokens read as viewers; instance administrators are owners everywhere.

last_upload_at.description: The latest SBOM upload; null before the first one.

stale.description: No SBOM for longer than the stale threshold (NANOBOM_STALE_AFTER_DAYS).

open.description: Open issues of the project's active versions by severity: a vulnerability of a package found in several versions counts once, at its highest severity.

ignored.description: Issues ignored in every active version that has them.

known_exploited.description: Open issues with a CVE in the CISA KEV catalog, counted like `open`.

url.description: The project's page in the interface.

name.description: Package name, with its namespace when it has one.

license.description: The license from the latest SBOM, as an SPDX license expression that may contain free-text license names (`MIT`, `Apache-2.0 OR MIT`, `LicenseRef-Proprietary`). `null` when the SBOM gives none, when the component is no longer in the project, or, for components stored before nanobom read licenses, until the project's next upload.

project_version.description: The project version holding the component; empty for the unnamed version.

project_version_active.description: Whether that version is active. Always `true` unless `inactive=true`.

license.description: The license from the latest SBOM, as an SPDX license expression that may contain free-text license names (`MIT`, `Apache-2.0 OR MIT`, `LicenseRef-Proprietary`). `null` when the SBOM gives none, when the component is no longer in the project, or, for components stored before nanobom read licenses, until the project's next upload.

known_exploited.description: A CVE of the finding is in the CISA KEV catalog.

kev_ransomware.description: CISA lists the CVE as used in ransomware campaigns.

epss_score.description: Probability of exploitation in the next 30 days (FIRST EPSS).

Exploitation.description: Aggregated over the finding's CVEs; empty when nothing is known.

version.description: The project version the finding belongs to; empty for the unnamed version.

severity.description: The highest severity among the vulnerability's aliases.

introduced_via.description: The project's direct dependencies that lead to the component; empty when the SBOM's dependency graph does not say.

ignore.description: Why the finding is ignored, while it is; null otherwise.

url.description: The finding's page in the interface.

user.description: The member who ignored or restored the finding.

token.description: The token that imported a VEX statement.

reason.description: The member's or the VEX statement's reason. For `inherited`, the name of the version the finding was copied from (empty for the unnamed version).

paths.description: From a direct dependency to the component, shortest first.

more.description: How many more direct dependencies lead to the component.

partial.description: The SBOM has links the graph could not keep: other paths may exist.

version.description: The project version holding the component; empty for the unnamed version.

name.description: The version name; empty for the unnamed version.

current.description: Whether this is the finding's own version.

status.description: `open` when one of the version's findings for the vulnerability is open, else `ignored` when one is ignored, else `fixed`; `not_affected` when the version never had one.

finding_id.description: The finding that decides the status, preferably of the same component; null when `not_affected`.

new_findings.description: Null for a whole-instance run, unless the caller is an instance administrator: the counts span every organization.

fixed_findings.description: Null for a whole-instance run, unless the caller is an instance administrator.

version.description: The project version the finding belongs to; empty for the unnamed version.

severity.description: The highest severity among the vulnerability's aliases.

introduced_via.description: The project's direct dependencies that lead to the component; empty when the SBOM's dependency graph does not say.

ignore.description: Why the finding is ignored, while it is; null otherwise.

url.description: The finding's page in the interface.

fixed_versions.description: Versions of the package that fix the vulnerability.

ignored_by.description: The member who ignored the finding, while it is ignored.

ignored_by_token.description: The token that ignored the finding from a VEX document, while it is ignored.

dependency_paths.description: Null when the latest SBOM did not say which components the project depends on directly.

affected_components.description: Other findings of the same vulnerability, in the active versions of projects the caller sees.

versions.description: Every version of the finding's project, newest first, with its status for the vulnerability or any of its aliases.

total.description: Items in the whole list, across pages.
Items in the whole list, across pages.

truncated.description: More components matched than the 200 returned: narrow the search (add a version prefix, or a longer name).

LicenseAction.description: What the policy does with a license, from the least to the most severe. Only `forbid` fails the upload gate (`fail_on=license`).

license.description: An SPDX license identifier in its canonical spelling (`GPL-3.0-only`), or `LicenseRef-...`. Matched case-insensitively.

active.description: Whether the policy can report anything: a rule or a default other than `allow`.

unlisted.description: The action for licenses no rule lists; `forbid` makes the rules an allowlist.

unknown.description: The action for components whose license is missing or is not a valid SPDX expression.

licenses.description: The license identifiers that lead to the verdict (`OR` keeps the least severe side, `AND` the most severe). Empty when the action for unknown licenses alone gives the verdict.

total.description: Items in the whole list, across pages: `forbidden` plus `warned`.

active.description: Whether the organization's policy is active.

warned.description: Components with a license the policy warns about.

name.description: The version name; empty for the unnamed version, which receives uploads that name no version.

latest.description: Whether this is the latest version, the one read when a request names none. Exactly one version of a project is latest.

last_upload_at.description: The version's latest SBOM upload; null before the first one.
